🎯 Today’s objective

By the end of this lesson I can...

✓ I can multiply by 10, 100 and 1000

✓ I can divide by 10, 100 and 1000

✓ I can change pounds to pence and m to cm, kg to g

So you can spot a bulk-buy bargain and change any unit!

Total first.

Answer
